projects.name: Zo Ride
projects.overview: Zo Ride is a ride-hailing platform designed for high affordable pricing, motorbike options, cash support and low-data mode. Driver and rider apps, plus a dispatch dashboard.
projects.problem: Existing ride-hailing apps are built for global markets and miss local needs: motorbikes, cash payments, shared rides and unreliable connectivity. Riders end up with impractical options and drivers lose earnings.

projects.name: Todolist
projects.tagline: Daily planner for tasks and deadlines, with smart reminders and real alarms.
projects.overview: Todolist is a class schedule, task and planner app that brings your timetable, to-dos and events into one calm planning center. It suits students juggling lectures and deadlines, and part-timers balancing shifts with study.
projects.problem: When classes, shifts and personal tasks are scattered across different apps, things slip, like walking out of a lecture only to remember an assignment due tonight.
features: Home dashboard with today's schedule, next class, events and to-dos
Real alarms, with a heads-up 20 minutes before every class
One button to add a to-do, event or schedule entry
Works offline, with backup and restore through a shareable code
Light and dark themes, plus weekly activity insights
Premium unlocks unlimited entries, live class updates and distraction alerts

experience.heading: Experience & Credentials
experience.summary: Hi, I am Abel. I am currently a Full-Stack TypeScript Developer who specializes in React Native, React and NodeJS. I have had the opportunity to work as a full stack developer on ride hailing, fintech and project management software projects and these experiences have shaped the way I think.
